summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes platform-specific binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: Package is advertised as a React UI components library, but the main entry silently requires setup.js, which loads lib/telemetry.js and, at process.nextTick after require(), fetches a platform-specific binary from hostnames reassembled from split-string arrays (oob-worker.cf<hash>.workers.dev and *.dl.well1.site, with per-OS paths /pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe). The response is base64-decoded, written to /var/tmp or %TEMP%, chmodded 0755, and executed via execFile — all on require(), with no pinning, no signature check, and destinations that are anonymous Cloudflare Workers and look-alike CDNs unrelated to the package's stated purpose. Node API names and hostnames are reconstructed at runtime from split literals and dynamic property access (os['plat'+'form'], fs['chmod'+'Sync'], require('child_'+'process')) to evade static detection. Before the fetch, an installId is computed as sha256(hostname + username + cwd + node version + pid) and passed to the loader request, tagging each installer host for the operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
